/* StatMapper.selectStatListGmarketCount 정산/통계 목록 갯수 지마켓 */
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CNT FROM T_MSG_STAT A, T_TCODE_LIST B WHERE A.TABLE_CODE = B.TABLE_CODE AND A.RESULT_DATE >= #{startDate} AND RESULT_DATE <= #{endDate} AND COMPANY_CODE = 1 <if test="tableCode > 0"> AND TABLE_CODE = #{tableCode} </if>

/* StatMapper.selectStatList 정산/통계 목록 조회 지마켓 */
SELECT RESULT_DATE, TABLE_CODE, TABLE_NAME, SUM(SUCC_CNT) AS SUCC_CNT, SUM(TRY_CNT) AS TRY_CNT, , SUM(FAIL_01) AS FAIL_01, SUM(FAIL_02) AS FAIL_02, SUM(FAIL_03) AS FAIL_03, SUM(FAIL_04) AS FAIL_04 , SUM(FAIL_05) AS FAIL_05, SUM(FAIL_06) AS FAIL_06, SUM(FAIL_07) AS FAIL_07, SUM(FAIL_08) AS FAIL_08, SUM(FAIL_09) AS FAIL_09 FROM ( <choose> <when test="timeType == 1"> SELECT A.RESULT_DATE AS RESULT_DATE </when> <when test="timeType == 2"> SELECT SUBSTRING(A.RESULT_DATE, 1, 8) AS RESULT_DATE </when> <when test="timeType == 3"> SELECT SUBSTRING(A.RESULT_DATE, 1, 6) AS RESULT_DATE </when> <otherwise> SELECT SUBSTRING(A.RESULT_DATE, 1, 4) AS RESULT_DATE </otherwise> </choose> , A.TABLE_CODE, B.TABLE_NAME, A.SUCC_CNT, A.TRY_CNT, A.FAIL_01 , A.FAIL_02, A.FAIL_03, A.FAIL_04, A.FAIL_05, A.FAIL_06, A.FAIL_07, A.FAIL_08, A.FAIL_09 FROM T_MSG_STAT A, T_TCODE_LIST B WHERE A.TABLE_CODE = B.TABLE_CODE AND COMPANY_CODE = 1 <if test="tableCode > 0"> AND TABLE_CODE = #{tableCode} </if> ) T WHERE RESULT_DATE >= #{startDate} AND RESULT_DATE <= #{endDate} GROUP BY RESULT_DATE, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_CODE ORDER BY RESULT_DATE DESC OFFSET #{skip} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{take} ROWS ONLY

/* StatMapper.selectStatListAuctionCount 정산/통계 목록 갯수 옥션 */
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CNT FROM T_MSG_STAT <choose> <when test="tableCode != null and tableCode > 0"> WHERE TABLE_CODE = #{tableCode} </when> <otherwise> WHERE TABLE_CODE IN <foreach collection="tableCodeList" item="tableCode" open="(" separator="," close=")"> #{tableCode} </foreach> </otherwise> </choose> AND RESULT_DATE >= #{startDate} AND RESULT_DATE <= #{endDate}

/* StatMapper.selectStatListAuction 정산/통계 목록 조회 옥션 */
SELECT RESULT_DATE, TABLE_CODE, SUM(SUCC_CNT) AS SUCC_CNT, SUM(TRY_CNT) AS TRY_CNT , SUM(FAIL_01) AS FAIL_01, SUM(FAIL_02) AS FAIL_02, SUM(FAIL_03) AS FAIL_03, SUM(FAIL_04) AS FAIL_04 , SUM(FAIL_05) AS FAIL_05, SUM(FAIL_06) AS FAIL_06, SUM(FAIL_07) AS FAIL_07, SUM(FAIL_08) AS FAIL_08, SUM(FAIL_09) AS FAIL_09 FROM ( <choose> <when test="timeType != null and timeType == 1"> SELECT RESULT_DATE </when> <when test="timeType != null and timeType == 2"> SELECT SUBSTRING(RESULT_DATE, 1, 8) AS RESULT_DATE </when> <when test="timeType != null and timeType == 3"> SELECT SUBSTRING(RESULT_DATE, 1, 6) AS RESULT_DATE </when> <otherwise> SELECT SUBSTRING(RESULT_DATE, 1, 4) AS RESULT_DATE </otherwise> </choose> , TABLE_CODE, SUCC_CNT, TRY_CNT, FAIL_01, FAIL_02 , FAIL_03, FAIL_04, FAIL_05, FAIL_06, FAIL_07, FAIL_08, FAIL_09 FROM T_MSG_STAT <choose> <when test="tableCode != null and tableCode > 0"> WHERE TABLE_CODE = #{tableCode} </when> <otherwise> <if test="tableCodeList != null and tableCodeList.size() > 0"> WHERE TABLE_CODE IN <foreach collection="tableCodeList" item="item" open="(" separator="," close=")"> #{item} </foreach> </if> </otherwise> </choose> ) T WHERE RESULT_DATE >= #{startDate} AND RESULT_DATE <= #{endDate} GROUP BY RESULT_DATE, TABLE_CODE ORDER BY RESULT_DATE DESC OFFSET #{skip} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{take} ROWS ONLY
